fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Visibility; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the driveway and walkway edges so responders can move quickly between the street, main residence, and detached structure without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can reach all sides of both buildings.
• Clear a walking path between the main residence and detached structure wide enough for two people to pass with equipment.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective markers so responders can identify the primary access point quickly at night or in low-visibility conditions.
• Post address numbers at the street that are large enough to read from a moving vehicle.
• Thin dense vegetation that blocks sightlines between the street and the main residence so responders can see the structure on approach.
• Identify which access points lead to the detached structure and mark them clearly so responders do not lose time searching.
• Keep vehicle parking areas clear of stored items so responders have room to stage equipment close to the structures.
• Trim vegetation overhanging the walkway so responders carrying equipment can move through without obstruction.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Large Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Open Terrain; Vegetation Along Driveway; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree clusters near the structure to create open gaps between tree canopies and the building.
• Trim branches on large trees closest to the structure so they do not hang over or touch the roof or walls.
• Remove or cut back shrubs that are growing directly against or immediately next to the structure.
• Thin shrubs scattered across the property where they grow close together and connect to the tree clusters.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles and emergency responders can pass through without obstruction.
• Clear low-hanging limbs from trees along the driveway to keep the travel path open and visible.
• Separate the bases of tree clusters from nearby shrubs by removing shrubs growing beneath or between the trees.
